name: seam-acp
description: A chat-platform bridge to ACP-compatible coding agents (Copilot, Claude Code, ...). Discord today, Slack tomorrow.
author: Jesse Bulpitt <jbulpitt>

scripts.build: npm run build -w @seam/adapters && npm run build -w @seam/core && npm run build -w @seam/bridge
scripts.redeploy: npm install --include=dev && npm run build && node -e "require('fs').writeFileSync('data/.restart-pending', '')" && echo 'Build complete — restart sentinel written'
scripts.dev: npm run build -w @seam/adapters && tsx watch packages/core/src/index.ts
